layout.yearStory.navigation.value: tap-through: tap right side = next, left side = previous; explicit pause / sound / close buttons in the top row; one progress segment per chapter

duration.yearStory.progress.segment.element: time for one segment to fill (= one chapter)

easing.yearStory.reveal.method: normalised position vs time; no named curve fitted
